_comment: Teacher-export scope (baselines/clef_teacher.py; JOB_SPEC.md section 11). TRAINING records only: the PR #44 150k m2 set named by the same pointer jobs/m2_first_cell trains on, drawn exactly as that cell draws (train.run_cell.split_ids over the set minus the pinned held-out D1-B exclusions, seed 0). Never Index DEV/TEST rows (SplitGuard over the harness DEV + TEST manifests and the pinned content index), never the frozen m2 cohort (dev/calibration/retention, by id and content), never a record carrying a held-out D1-B fragment (train.heldout). Any hit = exit 20 before any GPU phase.

draw.rule: train.run_cell.split_ids(sorted(set(manifest ids) - heldout_excluded.ids), n_records, 0, seed)[0]; identical to jobs/m2_first_cell (m2_first_cell_rwkv7.json: n_train_records 24000, seed 0)

heldout_excluded.source: jobs/m2_first_cell/m2_first_cell_rwkv7.json train_set.heldout_excluded (branch claude/m2-first-cell): train.heldout finds the D1-B fragment 'rather than relying on' in these three MMLU aux_train records

attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
